ModMetaData.name: D'thorga Framework
ModMetaData.author: Phobos A. D'thorga
ModMetaData.description:
The shared library the D'thorga mods build on. On its own it changes almost nothing; other mods ask it for what a colonist is breathing and for the small helpers they all share.
What it does:
- Reads the gases that already exist, from the game and from Combat Extended, and tells a mod what a colonist breathes through whatever mask or helmet they wear.
- Makes fires fill a roofed room with the game's own smoke when Combat Extended's smoke is not running, so burning buildings are smoky without it too.
- Carries its own room gases where nothing else does: in this version, carbon monoxide from fires, which lingers in a shut room after the smoke has cleared, drifts through an open door and ignores a gas mask. A gas exists in a room only while something adds it. There is no air, oxygen or pressure model.
- A setting chooses between reusing other mods' effects (the default), always using the framework's own gases, or never.
- With Vehicle Framework (RimWorld 1.7): gives vehicles real systems, found by what each vehicle runs on. A battery and alternator, coolant and oil, tyres or tracks, brakes and a gearbox, wear that a mechanic services, and parts that can fail. Every figure is in XML other mods can change. Choose in the settings which vehicles get them; before removing the mod from such a colony, press its removal button and save.
- Holds the care choices the D'thorga medical mods offer per person: once such a mod is active, each colonist, slave, prisoner and guest gets a button for them. On its own it adds no choice.
Safe to add to a running colony. Load it before any D'thorga mod that needs it. Needs no other mod.
